desc: Prove the bottleneck-distance property: \(f(x,y)\) is the maximum edge weight on the MST path between \(x\) and \(y\).
Derive and justify the Kruskal/DSU greedy matching rule for repeated values in A and B.
Design an efficient component-state representation for unmatched A and B occurrences, including handling vertices appearing multiple times.
Implement and validate direct all-edge Kruskal DSU with signed component imbalances and 64-bit answer.
Provide final stdin/stdout Python solution with correctness and complexity justification.
